name: Damsel
ability: All Minions know a Damsel is in play. If a Minion publicly guesses you (once), your team loses.
designRole: A publicly correct Minion guess of the Damsel loses for good; hidden identity creates social pressure.
explanation: A publicly correct Minion guess of the Damsel loses for good; hidden identity creates social pressure.

nightInstructions.firstNight: During Minion Info, show the Minions the Damsel token. If you haven't done this yet, do so now. If the Damsel was chosen by the Huntsman, show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
nightInstructions.otherNights: If the Damsel was chosen by the Huntsman, show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.

jinxes.reason: If a Pit-Hag creates a Damsel, the Storyteller chooses which player it is.
If the Spy is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
If the Widow is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
